sourceScope: Public PTT Stock-board actor/post/reply sequence, prospectively captured from the first verified live receipt onward.
actorSemantics: Public forum handle only. Never call a PTT handle a verified brokerage investor or natural-person trading account.

behavioralTransforms.leaderFollower: Estimate aggregate sequence-transition / stance-convergence patterns across distinct forum participants; do not produce persistent individual leader/follower profiles.
behavioralTransforms.adoptionHazard: Probability/rate that later forum actors adopt a previously observed stance/topic under frozen windows.
behavioralTransforms.residualHerding: Only the portion remaining after common-news, topic, market, sector and attention controls may be called social-herding evidence.
behavioralTransforms.reactionTypeGuard: Push/boo/arrow is reaction to the post, not automatically bullish/bearish stock stance.

ownershipFirewall.D06-19: future directly identified natural-person market primitives
ownershipFirewall.D20-06: social-herding/leader-follower transform on public forum actors
ownershipFirewall.sharedPrimitiveRule: One PTT receipt cannot become multiple independent selection votes.

falsification: Same-topic discussion caused by a common headline is not imitation.
PTT users are a selected subset and cannot represent all Taiwan investors.
High reply count is attention, not herding.
Forum stance may be performative, sarcastic or non-trading; classifier uncertainty stays UNKNOWN.
No claim of stock-market investor identity or actual order-flow herding.
l4Requirement: Prospective independent-date actor-sequence parents with frozen stance rules and common-news/topic controls; no retrospective reconstruction as Shadow evidence.

privacyGuard.rule: Public handles may be used transiently only to deduplicate distinct participants within a capture window. Derived research receipts must not retain named-user psychological, persuasion, or leader/follower scores.
